terms.meaning: the chosen language setting, here English or Hindi

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports
sections.what: Brings in the locale type, guidance and verification types, and the metrics helpers.

sections.name: relatedDocuments, text
sections.title: Related document selection
sections.what: For a verification item, gathers the documents it names and adds any documents whose identifiers end in current or support, with duplicates removed.
sections.why: Shows the user which records to look at together.
sections.watch_out: Matching by identifier ending means renaming document identifiers changes what is shown.

sections.name: checklist
sections.title: Checklist builder
sections.what: Picks a short list of bilingual steps. Steps depend on status: needs more information, or no action needed. For area consistency it asks for side-by-side area review and identifier checks. Other rules get their own steps.
sections.why: Gives a concrete next step for each kind of finding.
sections.watch_out: Each step has separate English and Hindi wording, so new steps need both.

sections.name: forResult
sections.title: Turns one verification result into guidance
sections.what: Takes one verification result and produces one guidance item. A potential issue becomes a review-now item, insufficient evidence becomes a request for more information, and any other outcome becomes a no-action item. Priority numbers set the order, with area items ranked ahead of family items, and the text is picked by language.
sections.why: Likely reason: the review order and wording are kept in one place so the same rules apply everywhere.
sections.watch_out: Any outcome other than the two flagged ones is treated as no action, so a new outcome type would be quietly hidden from the citizen.

sections.name: GuidanceService, guidanceService
sections.title: Service that builds the guidance list
sections.what: Turns every verification result for a case into guidance, sorts the items by priority, and records how long the work took. The shared instance exported here is what the rest of the app uses.
sections.why: Likely reason: one entry point for the whole list, with timing recorded for the team to watch.
sections.watch_out: Sorting uses priority only, so items with equal priority keep whatever order the verification results came in.

summary: Turns each verification item into a short set of plain next steps, with the related documents attached, in English or Hindi.
purpose: Tells a user what to check or keep next for each finding, without judging the land record.
why: Likely reason: the app is meant to guide users in their own language, so each step has both English and Hindi wording.
how: For each verification item, it gathers the related documents, then picks a short checklist based on the item's status and rule. Text is chosen by the locale setting. Parts of the file that assemble the final guidance were not included in the packet.
inputs: Verification items, the document list, and the locale.
outputs: Guidance items with related documents and checklist steps.
risks: Document matching depends on the wording at the end of document identifiers. Several parts of the file were not in the packet, so the full output could not be confirmed.
debug: If the wrong documents appear, check the identifier endings. If the wrong steps appear, check the status and rule values passed in. If Hindi text is missing, check the locale value.
